text:
ashley: seeing a sudden spike in 502/504s hitting the hosted API edge since ~2026-03-15T03:12Z. multiple customers reporting failed requests. grafana shows envoy.edge error-rate jump :eyes:

support_jorge: is this tied to a single customer or broad? any recent deploys?

ashley: broad — high-concurrency clients using HTTP/2 streams most affected. no recent prod deploys in the window. logs show upstream resets + TLS handshake alerts.

sre-oncall: grabbing logs now. can you paste a sample request id/time?

ashley: req_id=rcp-7f9a2c31 timeframe 03:12-03:20 UTC. envoy snippet:

```
[2026-03-15T03:13:02Z] envoy error: upstream reset: connection reset by peer, HTTP/2 RST_STREAM code=2
[2026-03-15T03:13:03Z] envoy warning: upstream request timeout to 10.2.5.11:8080
[2026-03-15T03:13:04Z] tls alert 40 from upstream (handshake failure)
```

infra_lina: same pattern in edge-proxy logs. occasional TLS alert 40 + backend closed socket immediately after ALPN. could be abrupt close from model-server process.

ashley: i tried a quick local repro using curl over http2 and got the same 502 + reset:

```
curl -v --http2 "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxx" -d '{"input":"test"}'
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS alert, handshake failure (40)
* Connection #0 to host api.redwood.example left intact
* HTTP/2 stream 1 was reset
* Connection was reset
```

sre-oncall: two likely culprits we've seen before: 1) mismatch between ALB/edge idle timeouts and upstream keepalives for long-lived HTTP/2 streams causing sudden RST_STREAM; 2) upstream model servers hitting FD/worker limits and closing connections abruptly.

deploy-bot: no deploys during the spike window.

support_jorge: customers report both short requests and streaming sessions failing, but streaming sessions fail much more.

infra_lina: posting current envoy cluster config snippet — might need to lower max concurrent streams and align timeouts:

```
cluster:
  connect_timeout: 5s
  http2_protocol_options:
    max_concurrent_streams: 100
    initial_stream_window_size: 65535
  lb_policy: ROUND_ROBIN
```

sre-oncall: short-term mitigations to try now:
- align idle timeouts between ALB -> envoy -> upstream (set all to 60s)
- reduce http2 max_concurrent_streams for edge cluster to 50
- enable short TCP keepalive on envoy->upstream (30s)
- add 502->fallback routing to smaller model-pool for noisy customers

ashley: i toggled envoy keepalive to 30s for a small canary and saw error rate drop by ~40% but TLS alerts still present for a subset of requests.

infra_lina: digging into model-server metrics — worker threads spike and fd_count approaches limit under burst; opening infra ticket to raise ulimit and monitor. probable root cause: backend overload + abrupt socket closes -> envoy reports RST_STREAM/502.

sre-oncall: plan-of-record:
1) immediate (30m): roll out envoy config changes (idle timeout + reduce http2 streams) to all edge instances, enable keepalive.
2) short (2h): increase ulimit on model servers, scale up model pool for affected shard.
3) medium (24-72h): add circuit-breaker + automatic fallback to lower-concurrency model variants, and enhance telemetry for TLS alerts.

ops-bot: @sre-oncall requested deploy: envoy-edge config patch v2026-03-15-ssl-probe -> starting rollout.

deploy-bot: rolling patch: 0% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%. monitoring metrics.

ashley: post-rollout graphs show error-rate back to baseline in us-west-2 and customer pings confirm reduced failures :thumbsup:.

support_jorge: contacting top affected customers with mitigation guidance (switch to short-lived REST calls / disable long-lived HTTP/2 streams until we're stable).

infra_lina: changed ulimit on model pool, added alert on fd_count and worker_queue_depth. will keep an eye for 12h.

sre-oncall: follow-ups: document tuning playbook (idle timeouts, http2 stream limits, keepalive), add automated rollback if 502 rate > threshold, and schedule postmortem if regression.

ashley: tagging @support_jorge @infra_lina for customer comms & infra followup. closing once stable 12h.

botnote: severity downgraded to S2.
